calls.reason: The clock study and disability-imagery study show recurring failures, but neither establishes whether the proposed shift toward reasoning about values occurred or whether it is needed to prevent them.

OpenAI's report confirms better images and persistent spatial failures, but attributes weaknesses to its captioner. The packet does not establish that missing intermediate world models explain the remaining problems.

The 2025 clock study finds default-time biases alongside hand-detection and angle difficulties. It does not test the October 2023 system or establish training-time frequencies as the cause of its errors.
The medical-imagery study documents other stereotypes, but does not test Black doctors with White patients. Neither training-data scarcity nor its effect on this pairing is established.
